40022228.author: पदार्थः
40022228.content: अथ then, रात्र्यां the night, प्रवृत्तायां having advanced, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, भृगुनन्दनम् the son of Bhrigu, पप्रच्छ he asked, च्यवनं Chyavana, विप्रं the brahmin, लवणस्य of Lavana, यथा how, बलम् the strength.

40022228.author: Translation
40022228.content: Then, as the night advanced, Shatrughna asked the brahmin Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, about the extent of Lavana's strength.

40022229.author: पदार्थः
40022229.content: शूलस्य of the trident, च and, बलं the strength, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, के who, च and, पूर्वं previously, विनाशिताः were destroyed, अनेन by this, शूलमुख्येन by the chief trident, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् single combat, उपागताः who engaged in.

40022229.author: Translation
40022229.content: O Brahmana, Shatrughna further inquired about the strength of the trident and who had previously been destroyed by this formidable trident when they engaged in single combat.

40022230.author: पदार्थः
40022230.content: तस्य his, तत् वचनम् that word, श्रुत्वा having heard, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः the great-souled, प्रत्युवाच replied, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, च्यवनः Chyavana, रघुनन्दनम् to the delight of Raghu's lineage.

40022230.author: Translation
40022230.content: Having heard those words of the great-souled Shatrughna, the greatly effulgent Chyavana replied to the scion of Raghu.

40022231.author: पदार्थः
40022231.content: असङ्ख्येयानि innumerable, कर्माणि deeds, यानि which, अस्य of him, रघुनन्दन O delight of Raghu's lineage, इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवे born in the Ikshvaku lineage, यत् वृत्तम् what happened, तत् that, शृणष्व listen, मे from me.

40022231.author: Translation
40022231.content: O scion of Raghu, listen to me about the innumerable deeds and the story of him who was born in the Ikshvaku lineage.

40022232.author: पदार्थः
40022232.content: अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, पुरा formerly, राजा king, युवनाश्वसुतः son of Yuvanashva, बली powerful, मान्धाता इति as Mandhata, सः he, विख्यातः renowned, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, वीर्यवान् valorous.

40022232.author: Translation
40022232.content: Formerly in Ayodhya, there was a powerful king, the son of Yuvanashva, who was renowned as Mandhata and was valorous in the three worlds.

40022233.author: पदार्थः
40022233.content: सः he, कृत्वा having made, पृथिवीम् the earth, कृत्स्नाम् entire, शासने under his rule, पृथिवीपतिः the lord of the earth, सुरलोकम् the world of gods, इतः from here, जेतुम् to conquer, उद्योगम् effort, अकरोत् made, नृपः the king.

40022233.author: Translation
40022233.content: Having brought the entire earth under his rule, that king, the lord of the earth, then made an effort to conquer the world of the gods from here.

40022234.author: पदार्थः
40022234.content: इन्द्रस्य of Indra, च and, भयम् fear, तीव्रम् intense, सुराणाम् of the gods, च and, महात्मनाम् the great-souled, मान्धातरि when Mandhata, कृतोद्योगे had made the effort, देवलोकजिगीषया with the desire to conquer the world of gods.

40022234.author: Translation
40022234.content: Intense fear arose in Indra and the great-souled gods when Mandhata made the effort with the desire to conquer the world of the gods.

40022235.author: पदार्थः
40022235.content: अर्धासनेन by half-seat, शक्रस्य of Indra, राज्यार्धेन by half-kingdom, च and, पार्थिवः the king, वन्द्यमानः being saluted, सुरगणैः by hosts of gods, प्रतिज्ञाम् a vow, अध्यरोहत he undertook.

40022235.author: Translation
40022235.content: The king, Mandhata, who was honored with half of Indra's seat and half of his kingdom, and saluted by the hosts of gods, then undertook a challenge.

40022236.author: पदार्थः
40022236.content: तस्य his, पापम् sinful, अभिप्रायम् intention, विदित्वा having known, पाकशासनः Indra, सान्त्वपूर्वम् gentle, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच he spoke, युवनाश्वजम् to the son of Yuvanashva.

40022236.author: Translation
40022236.content: Knowing Mandhata's sinful intention, Indra, the slayer of Paka, spoke these conciliatory words to the son of Yuvanashva.

40022237.author: पदार्थः
40022237.content: राजा king, त्वम् you, मानुषे in the human, लोके world, न not, तावत् yet, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, अकृत्वा without making, पृथिवीम् the earth, वश्याम् subservient, देवराज्यम् the kingdom of gods, इह here, इच्छसि you desire.

40022237.author: Translation
40022237.content: O best among men, you are a king in the human world, and you desire the kingdom of the gods here without first bringing the entire earth under your control.

40022238.author: पदार्थः
40022238.content: यदि if, वीर O hero, समग्रा complete, ते your, मेदिनी earth, निखिला whole, वशे under control, देवराज्यम् kingdom of gods, कुरुष्व do, इह here, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with servants, army, and vehicles.

40022238.author: Translation
40022238.content: O hero, if your entire earth is completely under your control, then you may establish the kingdom of the gods here with your servants, army, and vehicles.

40022239.author: पदार्थः
40022239.content: इन्द्रम् to Indra, एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, तम् to him, मान्धाता Mandhata, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् he spoke, क्व where, मे my, शक्र O Indra, प्रतिहतम् obstructed, शासनम् rule, पृथिवीतले on the surface of the earth.

40022239.author: Translation
40022239.content: To Indra, who was speaking thus, Mandhata replied, "O Indra, where on the surface of the earth is my rule obstructed?"

40022240.author: पदार्थः
40022240.content: तम् him, उवाच said, सहस्राक्षः Indra, लवणः Lavana, नाम named, राक्षसः demon, मधुपुत्रः son of Madhu, मधुवने in Madhuvana, न not, ते your, आज्ञाम् command, कुरुते obeys, अनघ O sinless one.

40022240.author: Translation
40022240.content: Indra informed (Shatrughna) that a demon named Lavana, son of Madhu, residing in Madhuvana, does not obey his commands, O sinless one.

40022241.author: पदार्थः
40022241.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, विप्रियम् unpleasant, घोरम् terrible, सहस्राक्षेण by Indra, भाषितम् spoken, व्रीडितः ashamed, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, राजा the king, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed.

40022241.author: Translation
40022241.content: Having heard those terrible and unpleasant words spoken by Indra, the king (Shatrughna) was ashamed and, with a downcast face, was indeed unable to speak.

40022242.author: पदार्थः
40022242.content: आमन्त्र्य having bid farewell, तु and, सहस्राक्षम् to Indra, ह्रिया with shame, किञ्चित् somewhat, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, पुनरेव again indeed, आगमत् came, श्रीमान् glorious, इमम् this, लोकम् world, नरेश्वरः the lord of men.

40022242.author: Translation
40022242.content: And having bid farewell to Indra, the glorious lord of men (Shatrughna), still somewhat ashamed and with a downcast face, returned to this world.

40022243.author: पदार्थः
40022243.content: सः he, कृत्वा having placed, हृदये in his heart, अमर्षम् indignation, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with servants, army, and vehicles, आजगाम came, मधोः of Madhu, पुत्रम् the son, वशे under control, कर्तुम् to make, अरिन्दमः the subduer of enemies.

40022243.author: Translation
40022243.content: Holding indignation in his heart, the subduer of enemies (Shatrughna) came with his servants, army, and vehicles to bring Madhu's son (Lavana) under his control.

40022244.author: पदार्थः
40022244.content: सः he, काङ्क्षमाणः desiring, लवणम् Lavana, युद्धाय for battle, पुरुषर्षभः the best among men, दूतम् a messenger, सम्प्रेषयामास sent, सकाशम् to the presence, लवणस्य of Lavana, हि indeed.

40022244.author: Translation
40022244.content: Desiring battle with Lavana, the best among men (Shatrughna) indeed sent a messenger to Lavana's presence.

40022245.author: पदार्थः
40022245.content: सः he, गत्वा having gone, विप्रियाणि unpleasant things, आह said, बहूनि many, मधुनः of Madhu, सुतम् to the son, वदन्तम् speaking, एवम् thus, तम् that, दूतम् messenger, भक्षयामास devoured, राक्षसः the demon.

40022245.author: Translation
40022245.content: Having gone and spoken many unpleasant things to Madhu's son, the demon Lavaṇa devoured that messenger who was speaking thus.

40022246.author: पदार्थः
40022246.content: चिरायमाणे when delaying, दूते the messenger, तु indeed, राजा the king, क्रोधसमन्वितः filled with anger, अर्दयामास tormented, तद्रक्षः that demon, शरवृष्ट्या with a shower of arrows, समन्ततः from all sides.

40022246.author: Translation
40022246.content: When the messenger delayed, the king, filled with anger, attacked that demon Lavaṇa from all sides with a shower of arrows.

40022247.author: पदार्थः
40022247.content: ततः then, प्रहस्य having laughed loudly, तद्रक्षः that demon, शूलम् the trident, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand, वधाय for the killing, सानुबन्धस्य along with his retinue, मुमोच released, आयुधम् the weapon, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022247.author: Translation
40022247.content: Then, that demon Lavaṇa laughed loudly, took the excellent trident in his hand, and released that supreme weapon to kill the king along with his retinue.

40022248.author: पदार्थः
40022248.content: तत् that, शूलम् trident, दीप्यमानम् shining brightly, तु indeed, सभृत्यबलवाहनम् along with servants, army, and vehicles, भस्मीकृत्वा having reduced to ashes, नृपम् the king, भूयः again, लवणस्य of Lavaṇa, आगमत् returned, करम् to the hand.

40022248.author: Translation
40022248.content: That brightly shining trident, having reduced the king along with his servants, army, and vehicles to ashes, then returned to Lavaṇa's hand.

40022249.author: पदार्थः
40022249.content: एवम् thus, सः that, राजा king, सुमहान् very great, हतः was killed, सबलवाहनः along with his army and vehicles, शूलस्य of the trident, तु indeed, बलम् the power, सौम्य O gentle one, अप्रमेयम् immeasurable, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40022249.author: Translation
40022249.content: Thus, that very great king was killed along with his army and vehicles; indeed, O gentle one, the power of that trident is immeasurable and unsurpassed.

40022250.author: पदार्थः
40022250.content: श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, तु indeed, लवणं Lavana, वधिष्यसि you will kill, न not, संशयः doubt, अगृहीतायुधं when he has not taken his weapon, क्षिप्रं swiftly, ध्रुवो certain, हि indeed, विजयस्तव your victory.

40022250.author: Translation
40022250.content: Tomorrow morning, you will certainly kill Lavana, and your victory is assured, especially when he has not taken up his weapon.

40022251.author: पदार्थः
40022251.content: लोकानां for the people, स्वस्ति welfare, चैव and indeed, स्यात् will be, कृते when done, कर्मणि the deed, च and, त्वया by you, एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातं has been told, लवणस्य of Lavana, दुरात्मनः the wicked one.

40022251.author: Translation
40022251.content: The welfare of the worlds will be achieved by this deed done by you, and all this about the wicked Lavana has been told to you.

40022252.author: पदार्थः
40022252.content: शूलस्य of the trident, च and, बलं strength, घोरम् terrible, अप्रमेयं immeasurable, नरर्षभ O best among men, विनाशश्चैव and indeed the destruction, मान्धातुः of Mandhata, यत् which, तेन by him, अभूत् happened, च and, पार्थिव O king.

40022252.author: Translation
40022252.content: O best among men, the terrible and immeasurable strength of the trident, and the destruction of Mandhata which was caused by him, has also been recounted, O king.

40022253.author: पदार्थः
40022253.content: त्वं you, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, लवणं Lavana, महात्मन् O great-souled one, वधिष्यसे you will kill, न not, अत्र here, तु indeed, संशयः doubt, मे my, शूलं the trident, विना without, निर्गतम् having gone out, आमिषार्थे for the sake of meat, ध्रुवो certain, जयस्ते your victory, भविता will be, नरेन्द्र O king.

40022253.author: Translation
40022253.content: O great-souled one, you will kill Lavana tomorrow morning; there is no doubt in my mind about this, and your victory will be certain, O king, when he has gone out without his trident for the sake of food. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 67 ।। Thus ends the sixty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
